--// DİL KAYDI (writefile/readfile varsa dosyaya kaydeder)
local LANG_FILE = "AllInOnePanel_lang.txt"
local currentLang = nil

local function loadLang()
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		if isfile and readfile and isfile(LANG_FILE) then
			return readfile(LANG_FILE)
		end
	end)
	if ok and result and TEXTS[result] then
		return result
	end
	return nil
end

local function saveLang(code)
	pcall(function()
		if writefile then
			writefile(LANG_FILE, code)
		end
	end)
end

currentLang = loadLang()

local function t(key)
	local pack = TEXTS[currentLang or "en"]
	return pack[key] or TEXTS.en[key] or key
end

--// DURUM
local flySpeed = 60
local flying, noclip = false, false
local upHeld, downHeld = false, false
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro, flyConnection, noclipConnection
local originalStates = {}
local spectating = nil

--// YARDIMCI FONKSİYONLAR
local function corner(obj, r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)
	c.Parent = obj
	return c
end

local function makeButton(parent, text, pos, size, color)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = size
	b.Position = pos
	b.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(35, 75, 145)
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.Text = text
	b.TextSize = 14
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.Parent = parent
	corner(b, 9)
	return b
end

local function isPress(i)
	return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local function isMove(i)
	return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local function makeDraggable(obj)
	local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil

	obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if isPress(input) then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = obj.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and isMove(input) then
			local d = input.Position - dragStart
			obj.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
			)
		end
	end)
end

local BLUE = Color3.fromRGB(35, 75, 145)
local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(30, 150, 90)

local function applyGradient(obj)
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(100, 210, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 50, 140))
	})
	g.Rotation = 90
	g.Parent = obj
end

--// GUI

gui.Name = "AllInOnePanel"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

applyGradient(frame)

local tabMove = makeButton(frame, "", UDim2.fromOffset(15, 38), UDim2.fromOffset(110, 30), GREEN)

moveFrame.Parent = frame

local downBtn = makeButton(moveFrame, "", UDim2.fromOffset(120, 150), UDim2.fromOffset(110, 35), Color3.fromRGB(30, 100, 200))

local function updateFlyBtn()
	flyBtn.Text = flying and t("flyOn") or t("flyOff")
	flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = flying and GREEN or BLUE
end

local function updateNoclipBtn()
	noclipBtn.Text = noclip and t("noclipOn") or t("noclipOff")
	noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = noclip and GREEN or BLUE
end

local function holdButton(btn, setter)
	btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if isPress(i) then setter(true) end end)
	btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if isPress(i) then setter(false) end end)
end
holdButton(upBtn, function(v) upHeld = v end)
holdButton(downBtn, function(v) downHeld = v end)

speedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local n = tonumber(speedBox.Text)
	if n and n > 0 then
		flySpeed = math.clamp(n, 1, 500)
	end
	speedBox.Text = tostring(flySpeed)
	info.Text = t("speed") .. flySpeed
end)

--// FLY
local function stopFly()
	flying = false
	if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() flyConnection = nil end
	if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
	if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end

	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = false end

	updateFlyBtn()
end

local function startFly()
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid then return end

	flying = true
	humanoid.PlatformStand = true

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	bodyGyro.P = 9000
	bodyGyro.CFrame = root.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	updateFlyBtn()

	flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not flying or not cam or not root.Parent then return end

		local move = cam.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(humanoid.MoveDirection)
		local direction = (cam.CFrame.LookVector * -move.Z) + (cam.CFrame.RightVector * move.X)

		if upHeld or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
			direction += Vector3.yAxis
		end
		if downHeld or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
			direction -= Vector3.yAxis
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = direction * flySpeed
		bodyGyro.CFrame = cam.CFrame
	end)
end

--// NOCLIP
local function stopNoclip()
	noclip = false
	if noclipConnection then noclipConnection:Disconnect() noclipConnection = nil end

	for part, original in pairs(originalStates) do
		if part and part.Parent then
			part.CanCollide = original
		end
	end
	table.clear(originalStates)

	updateNoclipBtn()
end

local function startNoclip()
	noclip = true
	updateNoclipBtn()

	noclipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
		local character = player.Character
		if not character then return end

		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if originalStates[part] == nil then
					originalStates[part] = part.CanCollide
				end
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function toggleFly() if flying then stopFly() else startFly() end end
local function toggleNoclip() if noclip then stopNoclip() else startNoclip() end end

flyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)
noclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleNoclip)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
		toggleFly()
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
		toggleNoclip()
	end
end)

	spectating = nil

		cam.CameraSubject = humanoid

local function addRow(plr)
	if rows[plr] then return end

	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = plr.Name
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
	row.BackgroundColor3 = BLUE
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0

	corner(row, 8)

	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -82, 1, 0)

	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	nameLabel.TextSize = 13
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = plr == player and Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 90) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	nameLabel.Parent = row

	if plr ~= player then
		local tpBtn = makeButton(row, "TP", UDim2.new(1, -74, 0, 4), UDim2.fromOffset(34, 26), Color3.fromRGB(30, 100, 200))
		local viewBtn = makeButton(row, "👁", UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 4), UDim2.fromOffset(32, 26), Color3.fromRGB(30, 100, 200))

		tpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local myRoot = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local targetRoot = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if myRoot and targetRoot then
				myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
			end
		end)

		viewBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if spectating == plr then
				stopSpectate()
				return
			end
			local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then
				spectating = plr
				workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = hum
			end
		end)
	end

	rows[plr] = row
	updateCount()
end

local function removeRow(plr)
	if rows[plr] then
		rows[plr]:Destroy()
		rows[plr] = nil
	end
	if spectating == plr then stopSpectate() end
	updateCount()
end

for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do addRow(plr) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(addRow)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removeRow)

	tabPlayers.BackgroundColor3 = tab == "players" and GREEN or BLUE
